description: This file defines the class 'matrix_t' along with its member functions for matrix operations such as inversion, determinant calculation, and eigenvalues, indicating it is part of a linear algebra utilities module.

classes.name: matrix_t
classes.description: A class implementing matrix operations and properties, including creation, manipulation, and various linear algebra calculations.

methods.name: set_row
methods.description: Sets the specified row of the matrix from a vector.

methods.name: set_col
methods.description: Sets the specified column of the matrix from a vector.

methods.name: get_row
methods.description: Retrieves a specified row as a vector.

methods.name: get_col
methods.description: Retrieves a specified column as a vector.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Overloaded multiplication operator for matrix multiplication.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Overloaded addition operator for matrices.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Overloaded subtraction operator for matrices.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Computes and returns the inverse of the matrix.

methods.name: adjoint
methods.description: Calculates the adjoint (classical adjugate) of the matrix.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Returns the determinant value of the matrix.

methods.name: minor
methods.description: Calculates the minor matrix after removing specified row and column.

methods.name: covariance
methods.description: Calculates the covariance matrix.

methods.name: conjugate
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of the matrix.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of the matrix.

methods.name: hermitian
methods.description: Returns the Hermitian (conjugate transpose) of the matrix.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the matrix (e.g., subtracts mean).

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Returns the trace of the matrix.

methods.name: linear
methods.description: Performs a linear transformation on a vector.

methods.name: eigen
methods.description: Calculates eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

methods.name: cholesky
methods.description: Performs Cholesky decomposition.

methods.name: eigen_vector
methods.description: Finds the eigenvector associated with a given eigenvalue.

methods.name: null_space
methods.description: Computes the null space of the matrix.

methods.name: row_reduced_echelon_form
methods.description: Computes the row reduced echelon form.

methods.name: faddeev_leverrier
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues using the Faddeev-Leverrier method.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints the matrix to standard output.

methods.name: matrix_t (constructors)
methods.description: Various constructors for initializing matrix objects, including size and data input.

methods.name: ~matrix_t
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up matrix object resources.
